resources.string: Free up space, one swipe at a time
SwipeClean shows your photos and videos one by one, so cleaning up takes minutes instead of hours.
Swipe left to mark for deletion
Swipe up to move to a folder
Needed to show your gallery. Everything stays on your phone: SwipeClean has no internet access, no ads and no analytics.
Nothing is deleted without your OK
Items you swipe left wait in the app\'s bin. Android asks you to confirm before anything is moved or deleted, and deleted items stay in the system trash for about 30 days.
If you set up a daily cleanup plan, SwipeClean will ask for permission to show a reminder notification.
SwipeClean can\'t work without access to your photos and videos. You can allow it in the app settings, under Permissions.
You haven\'t selected any photos yet
You gave SwipeClean access to selected photos only, so only those are shown.
The swipe screen arrives in the next build.
